title: Business Base Rate While a Northgate+ Business Fee Is on Payment Hold
content:
**Rule.** Paid benefits of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships do not apply on payment hold, and the Business earning schedule reflects that in the Business base rate of the line it settles:

An order is held when it was fulfilled on or after the membership's payment hold date, the billing period starting on that payment hold date carries a declined attempt, and the fee of that billing period settled after the fulfilled date or has not yet settled.

1. When the membership is not canceled on the fulfilled date and the order is held, the Business base rate is **1** percent, the Northgate Rewards rate, because paid benefits do not apply on payment hold.
2. When the membership is canceled on the fulfilled date, the Business base rate is zero and the line earns nothing at all.
3. Otherwise this rule does not replace the Business base rate.

**Records read.** The payment hold date on the membership record; the declined fee attempts on the membership ledger for the billing period that starts on that date; the settlement date of that billing period's fee charge; the membership's canceled date; and the fulfilled date of the order on Northgate Store and Online Orders.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical payment hold date 3 September 2031, the held fee settling on 9 September 2031, the period carrying a declined attempt, membership not canceled)**

| Order fulfilled on | Inside the hold window | Business base rate |
|---|---|---|
| 2 September 2031 | no | not replaced by this rule |
| 3 September 2031 | yes | 1 percent |
| 8 September 2031 | yes | 1 percent |
| 9 September 2031 (the fee settled on the fulfilled date, not after it) | no | not replaced by this rule |

**Fee not yet settled (hypothetical payment hold date 3 September 2031, the period carrying a declined attempt, the held fee still unsettled, membership not canceled)**

| Order fulfilled on | Held | Business base rate |
|---|---|---|
| 2 September 2031 | no, fulfilled before the payment hold date | not replaced by this rule |
| 6 September 2031 | yes | 1 percent |
